notes: The page at rest: the title, the search card, the code field, the submit button and the line of hints under them. `origin` is the title, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gaps between these boxes, not where the first one lands. `capture` is the card, because it is the region both clients draw identically; the raster around it is covered by the layout numbers. Widths are left out of the title deliberately: its width is the run of text, not a decision. Colours are left out deliberately too - they are what the raster proves. The states after a lookup (found, not found, rate-limited, unreachable) are separate recordings and are not part of this contract yet.

motion.notes: The search card children stagger in 100ms apart, each fading and rising 20px over 0.5s on load; the submit control lifts 2px on hover and settles on press, and a result enters from 24px below over 0.45s and leaves 20px upward over 0.15s. The same means the same order, travel and easing, and the app composes the same states without the network.

entries.moves: the search card children stagger in 100ms apart, each fading and rising 20px over 0.5s
entries.same: the same order, 100ms stagger, 20px travel and 0.5s easing; reduced motion shows the settled card

entries.gesture: hover over and then press the submit button
entries.moves: the button lifts 2px on hover, settles back, and shrinks 2% on press
entries.same: the same 2px lift, 2% press scale and focus ring; reduced motion keeps the colour change only

entries.moves: the result enters from 24px below over 0.45s and leaves 20px upward over 0.15s
entries.same: the same 24px entrance, 0.15s exit and final state; reduced motion shows the result without the entrance
